Evidence for the original mode (inferred, not recorded before): of 145 non-link executables in <каталог Homebrew> 143 are -r-xr-xr-x and only these two are -rw-------. issues.severity: LOW (design ambiguity, implemented the permissive reading)
issues.title: Design 3.2: 'Есть' column says tool_use_id, launched_agent_id, subagent_type, description are 'только PostToolUse', but the sentence below the table says the other keys of the table are allowed for any event if present in the input
issues.decision: checkLine (schema.js), used by the server and by parseLine, requires launched_agent_id and tool_use_id only for PostToolUse and accepts every allowed key on every event; buildWriteBody (hook) emits them only for PostToolUse. A line the server wrote is therefore always accepted by parseLine.
issues.needs: REVIEWER/TEST-DESIGNER to confirm; the stricter reading is a one-line change in REQUIRED_BY_EVENT/checkLine.

issues.title: Design 5.3 step 2 says a 413 stops reading and closes the connection
issues.decision: Implemented as: answer 413 at once (at Content-Length > 16384 or when the received bytes pass 16384), buffer nothing more, but keep reading and discarding up to 8 MiB / 5 s idle, and do not send Connection: close. Reason, measured: with an immediate close a client still sending (1 MiB body) got ECONNRESET and never saw the 413 (my first scratch run failed on it); 17 KB, 20 KB, 1 MiB and chunked bodies all get 413 now and the journal hash is unchanged. Memory stays bounded.
issues.needs: SECURITY-REVIEWER to accept or ask for the literal behaviour.

issues.title: Corrupt journal line warning numbering
issues.decision: 'Pixel Office: строка журнала <N> испорчена и пропущена' uses N counted from 0, as the design numbers lines everywhere (from, lines, entries); the second line of the file is N = 1. Server-start records: 'запись запуска сервера <N> ...', also from 0.

issues.title: Error reason unknown_key:<name>
issues.decision: The design says 4xx bodies do not repeat the request, but also lists unknown_key:<name>. The name is echoed only if it matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}, otherwise unknown_key:?; this is after the signature check, so only the owner's own processes can see it.

issues.title: Test seams and extra exports not named in the design
issues.decision: main(argv, env, io) reads optional io.nodeVersion (SV-39 has no other in-process way to fake Node 21 or 25; SV-43 can use an io.out.write that throws); the secret is read at listen() and, if the file is missing then, lazily at the first POST, so SV-41 (directory removed while running) gets 500 write_failed from the append and not 401; ensureSecret(dir, randomBytes) and createServer({stateDir, port, now, journal, publicDir, warn}) are as in the design; extra exports are listed in the summary.

issues.severity: PROCESS (Q13 candidate for DOC-UPDATER) and a proposal to raise the bar (quality-bar section 4)
issues.title: A recursive chmod in a test or verification cleanup follows symbolic links
issues.detail: Anti-pattern: cleanup helpers that chmod a whole temp tree (needed to delete files made unreadable on purpose) also chmod the targets of symlinks; the design's own HK-10 puts a symlink to process.execPath into a temp directory, so the same trap is waiting in the real tests. What was wrong: I made the cleanup and ran it on a tree with that symlink. Right way: chmod only named paths, skip symlinks (lstat/Dirent.isSymbolicLink), delete with fs.rmSync(recursive, force), and never run such a script with node itself as a link target without checking.
issues.proposal: Raise the bar: tests and verification scripts never change modes of files outside their own temp directory. Check: stat of process.execPath (mode and ctime) before and after npm run check is equal; a grep for chmodSync over tools/test lists only named paths.
